speaker: Doctor
text: The labs show a cholestatic pattern with elevated alkaline phosphatase, which is significant. Given your history of Ulcerative Colitis and sexual risk factors, are you currently taking any medications for your bowel disease, and have you had any recent upper abdominal pain or fever?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. I also have Scleral icterus, Multiple scratch marks on trunk and extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC). The combination of pruritus, scleral icterus, a cholestatic liver pattern (elevated ALP), and your history of ulcerative colitis is highly suggestive of PBC, possibly associated with autoimmune hepatitis or cholangiocarcinoma given the age and risk factors.
